findings: Revise `learner.overview.text`: it presents the proposed whole-graph borrowing of 才 for 在 as based on a sound match, but the cited evidence leaves 才’s ancient referent and object-name pronunciation unsettled and does not establish that object-name match. State that reuse of 才 for 在 is proposed while its sound basis remains unverified, citing `X-a3bd81e427db8a7f33a3` and `X-032c823cdf5efc9a0ced`.
